sections.content: At Asana, Roadmap Week meetings before each quarter let people from other functions sit in on teams’ planning—for example, Kramer, as head of marketing, could attend product roadmapping. These open meetings helped people get looped in and understand what teams were planning; “out loud” discussions surfaced major decisions, unresolved choices, and input. The cost or caveat was scalability: Kramer said the approach might not scale forever, even though it worked well early on.
